args: if [ -n "${MEMEX_LOCAL_PATH:-}" ]; then exec uv run --project "$MEMEX_LOCAL_PATH" --package memex-cli memex mcp run; elif command -v memex >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec memex mcp run; else echo 'Memex CLI not found on PATH. The plugin uses the memex you install yourself: uv tool install "memex-cli[mcp,server] @ git+https://github.com/JasperHG90/memex.git@latest#subdirectory=packages/cli"' >&2; exit 1; fi
